en.io: Accepts cloud credentials, environment context, or metadata access as inputs and yields enumerated asset maps, permission vectors, and escalation audit findings as outputs.
en.boundary: It functions as a reference methodology and CLI guidance documentation rather than an automated exploit execution tool or automated payload generator.
scenarios: Assessing cloud architecture security during authorized penetration tests
Evaluating privilege escalation risks in IAM configurations
Simulating post-compromise scenarios following credential leaks

zh.io: 输入云凭据、环境上下文或元数据服务访问权限，输出云资产枚举结果、权限映射及提权路径分析报告。
zh.boundary: 该 Skill 仅作为静态的方法论与命令参考指南，不包含全自动化的漏洞利用执行或实时目标攻击功能。
scenarios: 在授权渗透测试活动中评估云平台安全配置
排查 IAM 策略中潜在的权限提升与越权风险
模拟凭据泄露场景下的后渗透与横向移动路径分析
